## Problem

Describe the concrete need and link the relevant improvement-plan ID or owning documentation.

## Scope and reuse

Define the smallest useful outcome. Identify existing owners, helpers, APIs, fixtures or documentation to extend. State material exclusions and compatibility concerns.

## Acceptance criteria

- Describe observable behavior that establishes completion.
- Include relevant failure/recovery behavior.

## Verification and documentation

Name the affected test layer, successful controls, owning guides and remaining device/server proof. Explain any new dependency through need, alternatives and maintenance cost.

## Operational impact

Describe data, permission, migration or rollback implications when relevant. A proposal does not imply authorization for APK builds, live/destructive tests or deployment.
